Dashboard Implementation Plan ​

For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking.

Goal: Build the Dashboard page with net worth hero + daily delta, daily motivational quote, account cards grouped by type with staleness indicators, top movers, and a news feed (RSS always-on + NewsAPI optional).

Architecture: Add /api/dashboard/summary (net worth, delta, by-type balances), /api/news (RSS + optional NewsAPI, cached in news_cache table), and a static quotes list. The news router (stubbed in Foundation) gets full implementation here. RSS fetching uses feedparser. NewsAPI uses httpx. The frontend Dashboard page is rebuilt from its current placeholder.

Tech Stack: Python/FastAPI, feedparser, httpx, SQLAlchemy (NewsCache model), React 18, TypeScript

# backend/routers/dashboard.py
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from datetime import date, timedelta

from ..database import get_db
from ..models import Account, BalanceSnapshot

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/dashboard", tags=["dashboard"])

DEBT_TYPES = {"credit_card", "student_loan", "auto_loan", "personal_loan"}


def _latest_balance(db: Session, account_id: int) -> tuple[float, date | None]:
    snap = (
        db.query(BalanceSnapshot)
        .filter(BalanceSnapshot.account_id == account_id)
        .order_by(BalanceSnapshot.date.desc())
        .first()
    )
    return (snap.balance if snap else 0.0, snap.date if snap else None)


@router.get("/summary")
def dashboard_summary(db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    accounts = db.query(Account).all()
    by_type: dict[str, float] = {}
    total = 0.0
    yesterday_total = 0.0
    yesterday = date.today() - timedelta(days=1)

    for a in accounts:
        bal, snap_date = _latest_balance(db, a.id)
        sign = -1 if a.type in DEBT_TYPES else 1
        by_type[a.type] = by_type.get(a.type, 0) + sign * bal
        total += sign * bal

        # Yesterday's balance for delta
        prev = (
            db.query(BalanceSnapshot)
            .filter(
                BalanceSnapshot.account_id == a.id,
                BalanceSnapshot.date <= yesterday,
            )
            .order_by(BalanceSnapshot.date.desc())
            .first()
        )
        if prev:
            yesterday_total += sign * prev.balance

    return {
        "net_worth": round(total, 2),
        "previous": round(yesterday_total, 2),
        "delta": round(total - yesterday_total, 2),
        "by_type": {k: round(v, 2) for k, v in by_type.items()},
    }

@router.get("/top-movers")
def top_movers(limit: int = 5, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    from ..models import Holding
    accounts = db.query(Account).filter(Account.type.notin_(DEBT_TYPES)).all()
    movers = []
    for a in accounts:
        for h in a.holdings:
            if h.cost_basis is None or h.last_price is None or h.quantity == 0:
                continue
            mv = h.last_price * h.quantity
            cb = h.cost_basis * h.quantity
            gain = mv - cb
            pct = (gain / cb * 100) if cb > 0 else 0
            movers.append({
                "symbol": h.symbol,
                "account": a.name,
                "market_value": round(mv, 2),
                "gain_loss": round(gain, 2),
                "gain_loss_pct": round(pct, 2),
            })

    movers.sort(key=lambda x: x["gain_loss_pct"], reverse=True)
    gainers = [m for m in movers if m["gain_loss_pct"] > 0][:limit]
    losers = [m for m in reversed(movers) if m["gain_loss_pct"] < 0][:limit]

    return {"gainers": gainers, "losers": losers}

python
# backend/routers/news.py
import os
import hashlib
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional
import feedparser
import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from ..database import get_db
from ..models import NewsCache, Holding, Account, Setting

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/news", tags=["news"])

RSS_FEEDS = [
    "https://feeds.reuters.com/reuters/businessNews",
    "https://feeds.reuters.com/reuters/technologyNews",
    "https://finance.yahoo.com/news/rssindex",
    "https://feeds.feedburner.com/TheStreet-Banking",
]

CATEGORY_KEYWORDS = {
    "Markets": ["market", "stock", "equity", "S&P", "nasdaq", "dow"],
    "Tech": ["tech", "AI", "semiconductor", "software", "apple", "nvidia", "microsoft", "meta", "google", "amazon"],
    "Crypto": ["bitcoin", "crypto", "ethereum", "blockchain", "btc", "eth"],
    "Politics": ["fed", "federal reserve", "interest rate", "inflation", "treasury", "regulation"],
}


def _get_setting(db, key, default=None):
    import json
    s = db.query(Setting).get(key)
    if s and s.value:
        try:
            return json.loads(s.value)
        except Exception:
            return s.value
    return default


def _fetch_rss_articles(symbols: list[str], categories: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
    articles = []
    for feed_url in RSS_FEEDS:
        try:
            feed = feedparser.parse(feed_url)
            for entry in feed.entries[:20]:
                title = entry.get("title", "")
                url = entry.get("link", "")
                pub = entry.get("published", "")
                summary = entry.get("summary", "")
                text = (title + " " + summary).lower()

                matched_symbols = [s for s in symbols if s.lower() in text]
                matched_cats = [
                    cat for cat, kws in CATEGORY_KEYWORDS.items()
                    if any(kw.lower() in text for kw in kws)
                ]
                if not matched_symbols and not matched_cats:
                    continue

                articles.append({
                    "title": title,
                    "url": url,
                    "source": "rss",
                    "published_at": pub,
                    "symbols": matched_symbols,
                    "categories": matched_cats,
                    "_symbol_hit": bool(matched_symbols),
                })
        except Exception:
            continue
    return articles


def _fetch_newsapi_articles(symbols: list[str], categories: list[str], api_key: str) -> list[dict]:
    query = " OR ".join(symbols[:5]) if symbols else " OR ".join(
        kw for cat in categories for kw in CATEGORY_KEYWORDS.get(cat, [])[:2]
    )
    if not query:
        return []
    try:
        resp = httpx.get(
            "https://newsapi.org/v2/everything",
            params={"q": query, "sortBy": "publishedAt", "pageSize": 20, "language": "en"},
            headers={"X-Api-Key": api_key},
            timeout=8,
        )
        if resp.status_code != 200:
            return []
        items = resp.json().get("articles", [])
        return [
            {
                "title": a["title"],
                "url": a["url"],
                "source": "newsapi",
                "published_at": a.get("publishedAt", ""),
                "symbols": [s for s in symbols if s.lower() in (a["title"] + a.get("description", "")).lower()],
                "categories": [
                    cat for cat, kws in CATEGORY_KEYWORDS.items()
                    if any(kw.lower() in (a["title"] + a.get("description", "")).lower() for kw in kws)
                ],
                "_symbol_hit": any(s.lower() in (a["title"] + a.get("description", "")).lower() for s in symbols),
            }
            for a in items if a.get("title") and a.get("url")
        ]
    except Exception:
        return []


@router.get("/health")
def health():
    return {"status": "ok"}


@router.get("/feed")
def news_feed(db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    # Get all holding symbols from non-debt accounts
    accounts = db.query(Account).filter(
        Account.type.notin_({"credit_card", "student_loan", "auto_loan", "personal_loan"})
    ).all()
    symbols = list({h.symbol for a in accounts for h in a.holdings if h.symbol})

    news_categories = _get_setting(db, "news_categories") or ["Markets", "Tech"]
    news_api_key = os.getenv("NEWS_API_KEY")

    articles = _fetch_rss_articles(symbols, news_categories)
    if news_api_key:
        articles += _fetch_newsapi_articles(symbols, news_categories, news_api_key)

    # Deduplicate by URL
    seen = set()
    unique = []
    for a in articles:
        if a["url"] not in seen:
            seen.add(a["url"])
            unique.append(a)

    # Sort: symbol hits first, then by recency
    unique.sort(key=lambda x: (not x.get("_symbol_hit", False), x.get("published_at", "")), reverse=False)
    unique.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("_symbol_hit", False), reverse=True)

    # Strip internal field
    for a in unique:
        a.pop("_symbol_hit", None)

    return {"articles": unique[:40], "symbol_count": len(symbols)}

import { useMemo } from 'react'
import { useApi } from '../hooks/useApi'
import { api } from '../api/client'
import type { DashboardSummary, TopMovers, NewsFeed, Account } from '../types'

const QUOTES = [
  "The stock market is a device for transferring money from the impatient to the patient. — Buffett",
  "Do not save what is left after spending, but spend what is left after saving. — Buffett",
  "An investment in knowledge pays the best interest. — Franklin",
  "The individual investor should act consistently as an investor and not as a speculator. — Graham",
  "It's not how much money you make, but how much money you keep. — Kiyosaki",
  "The four most dangerous words in investing are: this time it's different. — Templeton",
  "Wide diversification is only required when investors do not understand what they are doing. — Buffett",
  "In investing, what is comfortable is rarely profitable. — Robert Arnott",
  "The secret to getting rich is to own a business, not work for one. — Buffett",
  "Financial freedom is available to those who learn about it and work for it. — Robert Kiyosaki",
]

function dailyQuote(): string {
  const dayOfYear = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(new Date().getFullYear(), 0, 0).getTime()) / 86400000)
  return QUOTES[dayOfYear % QUOTES.length]
}

const TYPE_ORDER = ['brokerage', 'roth_ira', '401k', 'hsa', 'crypto', 'real_estate', 'savings', 'checking', 'credit_card', 'student_loan', 'auto_loan', 'personal_loan']
const TYPE_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  brokerage: 'Brokerage', roth_ira: 'Roth IRA', '401k': '401(k)', hsa: 'HSA',
  crypto: 'Crypto', real_estate: 'Real Estate', savings: 'Savings', checking: 'Checking',
  credit_card: 'Credit Card', student_loan: 'Student Loan', auto_loan: 'Auto Loan', personal_loan: 'Personal Loan',
}

function fmt(n: number) {
  if (Math.abs(n) >= 1_000_000) return `$${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(2)}M`
  if (Math.abs(n) >= 1_000) return `$${(n / 1_000).toFixed(0)}k`
  return `$${n.toFixed(0)}`
}

function stalenessColor(lastUpdated: string | null): string {
  if (!lastUpdated) return 'var(--red)'
  const days = (Date.now() - new Date(lastUpdated).getTime()) / 86400000
  if (days < 3) return 'var(--green)'
  if (days < 7) return '#c9a96e'
  return 'var(--red)'
}

export default function Dashboard() {
  const { data: summary } = useApi<DashboardSummary>(() => api.get('/dashboard/summary'), [])
  const { data: movers } = useApi<TopMovers>(() => api.get('/dashboard/top-movers'), [])
  const { data: news } = useApi<NewsFeed>(() => api.get('/news/feed'), [])
  const { data: accounts } = useApi<Account[]>(() => api.get('/accounts'), [])

  const quote = useMemo(() => dailyQuote(), [])
  const delta = summary?.delta ?? 0
  const deltaColor = delta >= 0 ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--red)'

  const accountsByType = useMemo(() => {
    if (!accounts) return {}
    return accounts.reduce((acc, a) => {
      if (!acc[a.type]) acc[a.type] = []
      acc[a.type].push(a)
      return acc
    }, {} as Record<string, Account[]>)
  }, [accounts])

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Hero */}
      <div className="card mb-24" style={{ padding: '28px 32px' }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-3)', marginBottom: 8, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 1 }}>
          Net Worth
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontSize: 48, letterSpacing: -2, marginBottom: 6 }}>
          {summary ? fmt(summary.net_worth) : '—'}
        </div>
        {summary && (
          <div style={{ fontSize: 14, color: deltaColor, fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>
            {delta >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{fmt(delta)} since yesterday
          </div>
        )}
        <div style={{ marginTop: 16, fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--text-3)', fontStyle: 'italic', lineHeight: 1.4 }}>
          {quote}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Accounts by type */}
      {accounts && accounts.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mb-24">
          <div className="section-label mb-12">Accounts</div>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
            {TYPE_ORDER.filter(t => accountsByType[t]).flatMap(type =>
              accountsByType[type].map(a => (
                <div key={a.id} className="card" style={{ padding: '14px 16px' }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 6 }}>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-3)' }}>{TYPE_LABEL[type] ?? type}</span>
                    <span style={{ display: 'inline-block', width: 7, height: 7, borderRadius: '50%', background: stalenessColor(a.last_updated) }} />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 4 }}>{a.name}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontSize: 17 }}>
                    {fmt(a.balance)}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Top Movers */}
      {movers && (movers.gainers.length > 0 || movers.losers.length > 0) && (
        <div className="card mb-24">
          <div className="section-label mb-12">Top Movers</div>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 20 }}>
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--green)', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 0.5, marginBottom: 8 }}>Gainers</div>
              {movers.gainers.map(m => (
                <div key={m.symbol} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '5px 0', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', fontSize: 13 }}>
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{m.symbol}</span>
                  <span style={{ color: 'var(--green)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>+{m.gain_loss_pct.toFixed(1)}%</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--red)', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 0.5, marginBottom: 8 }}>Losers</div>
              {movers.losers.map(m => (
                <div key={m.symbol} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '5px 0', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', fontSize: 13 }}>
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{m.symbol}</span>
                  <span style={{ color: 'var(--red)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>{m.gain_loss_pct.toFixed(1)}%</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* News Feed */}
      <div className="card">
        <div className="section-label mb-12">News</div>
        {!news?.articles?.length ? (
          <div style={{ color: 'var(--text-3)', fontSize: 13 }}>Loading news…</div>
        ) : (
          news.articles.map((a, i) => (
            <div key={i} style={{ padding: '10px 0', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)' }}>
              <a href={a.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
                style={{ color: 'var(--text)', textDecoration: 'none', fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 1.4, display: 'block', marginBottom: 4 }}>
                {a.title}
              </a>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                {a.symbols.map(s => (
                  <span key={s} style={{ fontSize: 10, padding: '2px 6px', borderRadius: 4, background: 'rgba(201,169,110,0.15)', color: '#c9a96e' }}>{s}</span>
                ))}
                {a.categories.map(c => (
                  <span key={c} style={{ fontSize: 10, padding: '2px 6px', borderRadius: 4, background: 'rgba(92,84,68,0.2)', color: 'var(--text-3)' }}>{c}</span>
                ))}
                <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--text-3)' }}>{a.source}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
